title: Allied skiers sabotage the heavy water plant

tellings.quote: >> a team of like Nordic skiers or something to like take out the heavy water plant

plain: During the Second World War, Michels recalls, the Allies sent "a team of like Nordic skiers or something" to destroy a plant in Norway that made heavy water, a special kind of water used in early nuclear research that Nazi Germany needed. He mentions it in passing, from memory, in a conversation with a writer named Jason Jorjani about Hitler's secret weapons programmes, as part of the story of how the Nazi nuclear effort was stopped.
